title: The Day the Dinosaurs Ended
description: 66 million years ago, a rock about 10 km wide hit what is now Mexico. What that day actually looked like.

scenes.narration: Sixty-six million years ago, it was an ordinary morning. Then a second sun appeared in the sky.
scenes.image_prompt: prehistoric landscape with dinosaurs grazing near a river, a blazing fireball streaking across the sky like a second sun, late Cretaceous

scenes.narration: An asteroid about ten kilometres wide was falling toward what is now Mexico's Yucatán coast.
scenes.image_prompt: view from space of a huge rocky asteroid entering Earth's atmosphere above a shallow tropical sea, glowing plasma trail

scenes.narration: It struck at tens of kilometres per second and carved a crater around 180 kilometres wide. Today we call it Chicxulub.
scenes.image_prompt: massive impact explosion on a coastline, a towering column of fire and molten rock blasting upward, shockwave spreading across the sea

scenes.narration: Molten debris rained back down across the planet, heating the sky and sparking fires.
scenes.image_prompt: glowing red hot debris raining down on a burning forest at night, silhouettes of fleeing dinosaurs, sky glowing orange

scenes.narration: Giant tsunamis surged across the Gulf of Mexico.
scenes.image_prompt: an enormous tsunami wave rising over a prehistoric coastline with tall conifers, dark stormy sky, scale of a mountain

scenes.narration: Soot and dust blocked sunlight for months, and temperatures fell. Plants struggled, and food chains collapsed.
scenes.image_prompt: dark grey prehistoric world under a dim brown sky, dead leafless trees, ash covering the ground, a lone dinosaur in the gloom

scenes.narration: Around three quarters of species vanished, including every dinosaur except the birds.
scenes.image_prompt: dinosaur skeleton half buried in ash and sediment, a small feathered bird perched on a bone, faint sunlight breaking through

scenes.narration: Small mammals survived, and that's why we're here. Want the day the Moon was born next? Comment moon.
scenes.image_prompt: small furry early mammal emerging from a burrow into a recovering green landscape with ferns, soft morning light, hopeful mood
